posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
morph147:

how do badges work at gen con and if i want can i just pay at the door?

You can, but it will be a long, tedious line, eating in to your convention time.

Also, note that the badge gets you into the convention center, into the exhibit hall, and into a variety of things, BUT DOES NOT GET YOU INTO SCHEDULED EVENTS. You need to buy tickets for each event (though some things, like panels, are sometimes $0 tickets).
